The left hand moves away before a single forward body/shoulder shift and right-arm thrust. The sphere remains above the right palm and grows in perspective, temporarily covering the face. Feet are outside this medium view; the visible upper-body thrust is clear.

The extended arm and swirling sphere are held while the camera closes in and shifts sideways. The face becomes readable beside the sphere, but the near hand/fingers and lower arm portions are cut by the bottom boundary. There is one sphere and no duplicate character.
